First value

Know what happens after a verified membership starts.

Payment alone is not first value. Franklin Navigator must connect the right account, organization, location and profile, then make the selected benefits usable.

1. Confirm

Receipt, plan, billing interval, Founding30 terms and renewal timing are shown clearly.

2. Link

The authorized person is linked to the correct Franklin profile, organization and subscribed location.

3. Improve

Complete the richer profile, media, contact and service information appropriate for the tier.

4. Grow

Open the Growth Desk and begin a practical, measurable 30-day local visibility plan.

Activation rule: These paid steps remain unavailable until the Franklin membership is verified and safely saved.
